zh-CN: 修复 Windows 安装目录、程序身份、图标与卸载快捷方式清理，安装版继续保留用户数据。
批量小项目使用合并提示并逐项写入日志；压缩包目录缺失时先询问创建、重新选择或取消。
收纳设置可折叠，工作台对齐、页脚贴底和顶部导航换行得到优化。
完善 MCP 启动诊断、无副作用预检、幂等请求、托盘状态和 AI 快速上手。
en-US: Fixed Windows install paths, executable identity, icons, and shortcut cleanup while continuing to preserve user data.
Batch small-item intake now uses one message with per-item logs; missing archive folders require create, reselect, or cancel confirmation.
Archive Setup is collapsible, with improved Workbench alignment, bottom footer placement, and responsive top navigation.
Improved MCP startup diagnostics, side-effect-free planning, idempotent requests, tray status, and AI quick-start guidance.
